footage.zone: Thunderhead (Palisades?) near Control Point Fault Lever ('Control Point: Fault Lever' banner)

text.subject: Class IV Stalker under the bridge by Foxtrot Outpost (5,-5)
text.quote: A Class IV Stalker spawns beneath the bridge next to Foxtrot Outpost every 15 minutes (at 5, -5 ...)
text.notes: Stalker is a big war machine, closer to a mini-boss than ambient fauna; still unchanged on page in 2008-09.

text.subject: Stalker counting for Restraining Order (Mires lava flats)
text.quote: Respawn rate about six minutes.
text.notes: Mission 976; final-era observation.

text.subject: Miasma bulls at Vogren's Tomb
text.quote: Typically only 4-5 bulls spawn at one time.  Respawn rate is about 5 minutes.
text.notes: Final-era (F2P period).

text.subject: Kael south of AFS Resistance Camp (-350,-435)
text.interval_or_statement: qualitative: "respawn fairly quickly"; 2-4 at a time
text.quote: two to four Kael who respawn fairly quickly

text.subject: Beam Manta Glider Captains around (200,-230)
text.quote: These are significantly easier to kill than the Beam Manta Glider Captains you will find around 200, 250, -230 and respawn frequently.
text.notes: Grammar ambiguous: "respawn frequently" may refer to the Floaters or the Captains.

text.subject: Flare Gashers before Staal Junkyard bridge
text.quote: They have a pretty short respawn time so it's easy to count your kills to 20

text.subject: Caretakers near the Destruction logos shrine
text.quote: there are two on quick respawn near the shrine of [[Destruction (logos)]]

text.subject: Thrax, Lightbenders and Kael around the Bane bunker
text.quote: [[Thrax]], [[Lightbender]]'s and [[Kael]] respawn very quickly around the bunker.
text.notes: Zone not re-verified in this pass.

text.subject: Warnets (with Kennilaxx) near River-base Krimm
text.quote: ... the [[Warnet]] infested area where I have seen them kill him because of there high respawn rate
text.notes: Final-era; Palisades was reworked in D12.5 (2008-09-18: spawns thinned/rebalanced).

text.subject: Patrols near Camp Cato/Camp Inferno bridge (Maalev area)
text.quote: The area is full of fast respawning patrols

text.subject: Bane in the yard (Out of Thin Air)
text.quote: The ones in the yard respawn after death.

text.subject: Tree Lurker Cubs west of a Wilderness camp
text.quote: Two Tree Lurker Cubs are there, and they respawn every few minutes.
text.notes: OBSOLETE for Wilderness (rebuilt D11, 2008-08-14). Do not use as analogue for rebuilt content.

text.subject: Howlers (3) with a Hunter at 533,275,307 near Badlands CP
text.quote: There is one area of the zone that has a reliable respawn of 3 Howlers with a Hunter
text.notes: Date unverified (TTH node ids ~16000 are Dec 2007).

text.subject: Divide: Hominis Machina patrol (Officers Varga & Hraak + 4 Hominis escort)
text.interval_or_statement: "every few minutes, then stop spawning for an unknown period of time"; unlooted corpse blocks that individual's next spawn
text.quote: They will spawn at the edge of Thoria Das by the fire pit (around 130, 850) every few minutes, then stop spawning for an unknown period of time... If a corpse is left unlooted that individual will not spawn in the next spawning until it is looted.
text.notes: Final-era. Earlier (2007-11/2008-01) text: "I never saw them spawn for about half an hour ... on Divide District 1 this group spawned multiple times" (rev 14477/25606, removed).

text.subject: Divide: Bane patrols the Bane Battle Plans mission wants
text.interval_or_statement: qualitative: patrol "travels that area's roads all the time"; revisit periodically
text.quote: The wandering enemy patrol that you seek travels that area's roads all the time. Even if you miss them on your first trip, it's not a big deal.
text.notes: Launch-era; Divide not known to be rebuilt.

text.subject: Palisades: Bane Hunting Party patrol
text.quote: 1/24/09 - Found the patrol at the above spot (485,300) after approximately 5 minutes of waiting.
text.notes: Final-era.

text.subject: Incline: named target next to crate (Intercept and Exterminate)
text.quote: She spawns next to the crate every 3-4 minutes.

text.subject: Respawn tied to corpse fade: looted corpses fade and respawn sooner
text.zone: Control Point (generic, written for a Torden CP)
text.quote: Do not loot the bodies if you can avoid it, as looted bodies fade (and therefore respawn) faster than bodies with any loot in them.
text.notes: Final-era; consistent with Up and Atta'em (2008-11-10) and the Hominus patrol note (2008-09-13).

text.subject: Unlooted corpses delay respawn
text.quote: clear the field ... of any atta and xanx, but do not loot their corpses. This will keep them from respawning for a while.
text.notes: Final-era.

text.subject: Caves of Donn: loot corpses so they do not respawn (contradicts the above)
text.quote: pick up the corpse loot from the machinas as you kill them, if possible, to make sure they don't respawn
text.notes: Pre-launch/launch instance note; conflicts with the 2008 corpse-fade statements. Unreconciled.

text.subject: Meat Grinder (Divide ToO boss, trench south of Delta)
text.interval_or_statement: ~6 min (rev 12833) then edited to "7 Minute Respawn Aprox." (rev 12835)
text.quote: He usually spawns south of Delta Outpost, near location 543, 49, -532. (7 Minute Respawn Aprox.)
text.notes: Carried unchanged through 2008-10; no later contradiction found.

text.subject: Caretaker Mordra (Divide ToO boss, lvl 24)
text.quote: The time between spawns is at least 50 minutes. (As of Deployment 11.6, spawn time has been reduced to approximately 10 minutes.)
text.notes: Late-era value ~10 min. "Deployment 11.6" patch-note text not found in cached captures (deployment_11360.html has no content).

text.subject: Buzzrup (Warnet boss, Horsetail Falls)
text.quote: Respawn is about 2 minutes and he's no tougher than other warnets.  He spawns with about 5 other warnets.
text.notes: Written 4 days before D11 went live (2008-08-14); Wilderness rebuilt in D11, so may be obsolete.

text.subject: Lawfoid / Mirtanz (Thrax Technician bosses + 3-4 technicians)
text.quote: he respawns every 5-10 minutes.
text.notes: Palisades reworked D12.5 (2008-09-18); may be obsolete.

text.subject: Kennilaxx (Palisades boss)
text.quote: Respawn time: 5-10 Minutes
text.notes: Final-era.

text.subject: Cavalon (Pools named Bane w/ escort)
text.quote: He respawned there twice on top of me as I was writing this in another window.
text.revision: first 35895 (2009-01-18, BluSky) quoting a 19 July 2008 sighting
text.notes: Suggests a few-minute timer.

text.subject: Grumble (Pools named)
text.interval_or_statement: qualitative: waited for respawn, it came back nearby
text.quote: I waited for respawn and he DID respawn just a short bit away

text.subject: Overseer P'toryc and group
text.quote: [[Overseer P'toryc]] and his group will respawn, so if you go there and the overseer is dead ... wait for a bit.

text.subject: Hygax (lvl 20 Palisades boss); Nyxroq-area named
text.interval_or_statement: "wait around a few minutes for him to respawn"
text.quote: If you don't immediately spot him, wait around a few minutes for him to respawn.
text.notes: Qualitative "a few minutes".

text.subject: Conscript Naan (Divide mission Thrax officer)
text.quote: he currently spawns frequently enough a few circles around the base should locate him
text.notes: Launch-era.

text.subject: Bane named boss in Gellman Meadow (Wilderness)
text.interval_or_statement: qualitative: "wait ... until his spawn time cycles back"
text.quote: If you dont see the Boss right away, wait around for a bit until his spawn time cycles back through.
text.notes: Obsolete zone layout.

text.subject: Named quest mob (beta preview)
text.quote: One named quest mob seemed to respawn quickly ... killing him 5 times before getting his head (paraphrase via search summary)
text.notes: Beta-era; page not fetched directly (search-summary only) - low weight.

text.subject: Divide: Bane food crates (Care and Feeding of Prisoners)
text.interval_or_statement: "longer than usual, several minutes or so"
text.quote: Note that the respawn times for these crates is longer than usual, several minutes or so.
text.notes: Implies "usual" crate respawn is shorter than several minutes. TTH 13755 gives the two crash sites (-5.6,130.2) and (-88.0,89.5).

text.subject: Divide: ambient ammunition crates
text.interval_or_statement: fixed to "take proper damage and respawn" (no interval)
text.quote: Ambient ammunition crates in Foreas divide will now take proper damage and respawn.
text.revision: TaRapedia rev 27883 (2008-01-29, Dashiva); also rgtr copy research/20260926-reward-items/work/rgtr-patch-1.4-20080129.txt
text.notes: Official live patch note (original tier for the fact of respawn; no interval).

text.subject: Devil's Den Eloh artifact containers
text.quote: The artifacts are located in containers near each of the three main bosses, and respawn every 1-2 minutes.
text.notes: Final-era. Brady (2007-10) also: "There are only a few crates, but they respawn very quickly." Patch 1.4 (2008-01-29): "Destroyed objects in Devil's Den should no longer respawn" (destroyables, not these containers).

text.subject: Centrifuge crystal crates (Crater Lake Research Facility)
text.quote: they will respawn given a minute or two

text.subject: Mires Barb Tick "Machinery" destructible
text.interval_or_statement: re-spawns every one minute (spawns 6 Barb Ticks)
text.quote: The Machinery, when destroyed, re-spawns every one minute.
text.notes: Final-era.

text.subject: Mires crates for "Unlockable"
text.quote: Fixed bug by increasing timer on respawning crates for mission "Unlockable" on Mires, set the timer to three minutes.
text.notes: Official patch note - an original value for that object.

text.subject: Nyxroq bunker crates
text.quote: The crates will take a few minutes to respawn

text.subject: Saccharo roots (Plateau harvestables)
text.quote: while you may not see many, they do respawn quickly

text.subject: Instances generally
text.interval_or_statement: "respawn much less frequently or not at all"; zoning resets
text.quote: Unlike on the battlefield, monsters in instances respawn much less frequently or not at all ... Zoning in or out of an instance will "reset" it
text.notes: Beta-era text kept to the end.

text.subject: Retread Caves Miasmas
text.interval_or_statement: "quick respawn" -> "As of January 2008, the miasma no longer respawn"
text.quote: As of January 2008, the miasma no longer respawn.

text.subject: Cuthah Base Sentinels
text.quote: Cuthah Base: Sentinels now have slower respawn times
text.notes: Official live patch note.

text.subject: Lamna Armory bosses
text.interval_or_statement: Gaite and Fearce respawn; Kewl does not
text.quote: Gaite will respawn, so you likely will have to kill him twice (or more)... This boss does not respawn... Fearce and his minions do respawn.

text.subject: Operation Overlord key-card holders
text.quote: each of these three respawns rather rapidly, and several engineers respawn around the Lightbender

text.subject: Open-world area respawns during an instance run
text.interval_or_statement: area cleared before an instance "will likely have respawned" after the run
text.quote: Note that the area you cleared before entering this instance will likely have respawned.
text.notes: Bounds open-world respawn to below a typical instance-run duration (tens of minutes).

text.subject: Palisades/Incline/Plains respawns; Divide & Wilderness spot adjustments
text.quote: Respawns: Palisades, Incline, and Plains have had their spawns significantly adjusted to better balance spawn across the full map. Divide and Wilderness have had spot adjustments to remove a few excessively tough areas.
text.notes: Official. Says nothing about timers; "Respawns" is the section label.

text.subject: PvP/CP base defenses
text.quote: Base defenses have been beefed up, but put on much longer respawns
text.notes: Wargame map section.

text.subject: Plains GPS beacon (Operation Termination)
text.quote: Adjusted respawn timer for Plains: Operation Termination GPS beacon

text.subject: Divide Deployment 14 dynamic spawners
text.quote: Dynamic spawners are additional reactive elements ... specifically focus on the presence of players
text.notes: Final-era Divide change; mechanism/timers unknown.

ambient_numeric: Divide Class IV Stalker 15 min (2007-11, unchanged to 2008-09)
text_summary.ambient_qualitative: "respawn fairly quickly / frequently / very quickly / short respawn" for open-world groups (Kael, Manta, Flare Gashers, Caretakers, Thrax) - consistent with a few minutes
named_numeric: Caretaker Mordra >=50 min -> ~10 min after D11.6 (2008-08)
Hominus patrol "every few minutes, then pauses" (2008-09)
objects: Divide food crates "several minutes", longer than usual (Brady 2007-10)
text_summary.mechanic: Several final-era players state respawn is tied to corpse removal: looted corpses fade sooner and respawn sooner; unlooted corpses delay the respawn (2008-09..2008-11). One 2007 instance note says the opposite.
text_summary.gaps: No official numeric respawn timer for ambient creatures was found. No forum (plaync/rasaworld/mmorpg) post with a timer was found by web search; archived forums not fetched.
